documents.text: Semantic search must apply project metadata before the nearest-neighbor result limit; otherwise unrelated vectors can hide the best in-project result.
Capture normalization shares timestamp, host, exit code, project detection, and metadata handling across direct logging, wrappers, and history importers.
TUI filter policy is pure: metadata parsing, active filtering, distinct options, and counts are independent from Ink rendering.
The MCP server exposes project memory, project context, prompt search, prompt lookup, and chronological timeline tools over stdio.
Claude history import scans project JSONL transcripts, pairs each user message with the next assistant text, and skips thinking and tool blocks.
Gemini history import reads session JSON, pairs human messages with the following model response, and supports dry run and duplicate filtering.
Remote sync pushes unsynced prompts and pulls newer records; sync hashes deduplicate matching prompt, response, tool, and arguments.
Background analysis appends project memories and merges key insights and technical decisions into a single project summary.
getProjectContext and formatProjectContext are shared by ph context, chat, and MCP; semantic retrieval must stay project scoped.
Wise provides OpenRouter and MLX-Serve providers in ph; provider and model configuration is shared across CLI and TUI.
HOMO uses the shared Wise library to configure multiple AI providers behind the application's AI integration.
Chapter Genesis carries previous content fragments and book-level lore constraints into generated scenes.
PicoT uses SQLite and Next.js; builds should use a SQLite timeout and isolated build data to avoid SQLITE_BUSY races.
PicoT document preview preserves the originating library listing, search, and filters through breadcrumb navigation.
Lens integrates the harness goal loop with verified predicates, progress, recovery, and a run_command tool.
Lens WiseProvider supports OpenRouter and MLX-Serve using configured provider model IDs.
React rendering uses reconciliation to compare virtual trees and update the browser DOM.
Go goroutines communicate using channels and are scheduled by the Go runtime.
